promotion.name: Labor Day Weekend Specials
promotion.terms: Valid September 1–7, 2026. Labor Day pricing applies to the listed treatments only and is honored at checkout. Cannot be combined with other offers, packages or gift card promotions. Appointments subject to availability — holiday weekend slots fill quickly.

services.name: Aroma Express Facial + Aroma Express Massage — $89
services.description: A 30-minute aroma express facial and a 30-minute aroma express massage — one full hour of head-to-toe reset for $89.
services.fullDescription:
One hour, two treatments, one price.

Start with a 30-Minute Aroma Express Facial — cleansing, aroma steam, light exfoliation and a hydrating mask to refresh and rebalance your skin. Then move straight into a 30-Minute Aroma Express Massage, working through the shoulders, neck and back to release everything the week put there.

It is the treatment to book when you have exactly one hour and want to leave feeling like a different person.

Labor Day pricing — $89 for the full 60 minutes. Offer ends Monday, September 7.
benefits: Full 60 minutes for one flat price

services.name: 60-Minute Deep Facial with Microdermabrasion — $89
services.description: A full 60-minute deep cleansing facial with microdermabrasion resurfacing included — $89 instead of $120.
services.fullDescription:
Our deep pore cleansing facial with microdermabrasion added at no extra charge.

The facial covers a full cleanse, aroma steam, extractions, herbal eye treatment and a mask matched to your skin. Microdermabrasion then resurfaces the top layer, lifting away dull, dead skin and softening fine lines, texture and the look of pores.

This is the one to book if summer left your skin congested, uneven or just tired. Skin looks brighter and feels smoother immediately, with no downtime.

Normally $85 for the facial plus $35 for the microdermabrasion add-on. For Labor Day weekend, $89 for both. Offer ends Monday, September 7.
benefits: Deep pore cleansing facial with extractions
Smooths texture and softens fine lines

services.name: Underarm or Chin Laser Hair Removal — $59
services.description: Choose an underarm or chin laser hair removal session for $59 — normally $70 to $100 depending on the area.
services.fullDescription:
The two areas people ask about most, at one Labor Day price.

Pick either underarms or chin and book a full laser session for $59. Treatments take about 15 minutes and use the same medical-grade laser and the same technique as every other area on our menu.

Laser works on a schedule — sessions run four to six weeks apart, so starting now means real results well before next summer. If you have never had laser with us, Laura will check your skin and hair type first and tell you honestly how many sessions your area will need.

Regularly $70–$100 depending on the area. Offer ends Monday, September 7.
benefits: Your choice of underarm or chin

services.name: 60-Minute European Facial + Your Choice — $99
services.description: A 60-minute European deep pore cleansing facial plus your choice of an aroma express massage or a body scrub with shower — $99.
services.fullDescription:
Our signature European Deep Pore Cleansing Facial, and then you choose how to finish.

The facial runs a full 60 minutes: cleanse, aroma steam, exfoliation, extractions, face and neck massage, herbal eye treatment and a mask selected for your skin.

Then pick one:
• Aroma Express Massage — targeted work on the neck, shoulders and back
• Body Scrub with Shower — full-body exfoliation followed by a warm shower, leaving skin soft and polished head to toe

Labor Day weekend price is $99 for both. Booked separately, the facial and body scrub alone run $160. Offer ends Monday, September 7.
benefits: Full 60-minute European deep pore cleansing facial
Your choice of aroma express massage or body scrub
Body scrub option includes a warm shower

services.name: Lash Lift — $89
services.description: A lash lift that curls and lifts your natural lashes for six to eight weeks — $89 instead of $99.
services.fullDescription:
Wake up with lifted, wide-open eyes and skip the curler entirely.

A lash lift reshapes your own natural lashes from the base up, giving a soft upward curl that holds for six to eight weeks. No extensions, no glue, no fills, and nothing to maintain between appointments. Mascara goes on beautifully afterward, but most clients find they need far less of it.

The treatment takes about an hour and is completely comfortable — you rest with your eyes closed the whole time.

Regularly $99. Labor Day weekend price is $89. Offer ends Monday, September 7.
benefits: Lifts and curls your own natural lashes
